statements.statement: FY25 year-end closeout responsibility was fully transferred to an outside CPA firm and free cash is very unlikely to be certified before the special town meeting, though no appropriations depend on it this cycle.
The Governor is pulling back a statewide pool of local earmarks and the town has not been told whether its two school earmarks are affected.
One at-risk school earmark would fund guidance, mental health, and special education service enhancements.
A second at-risk school earmark would fund security system upgrades.
